title: Advanced Settings
subtitle: Custom configurations & embeds
description: Gain full control over your Mailman experience. We will be opening up all the core settings, allowing you to embed your own custom configurations and tweak the AI's behavior to perfectly match your personal or organizational needs.

title: OCR Image Chunking
subtitle: Smart image text extraction
description: Never miss important context trapped inside screenshots again. We are adding advanced Optical Character Recognition (OCR) designed specifically for image chunking, allowing Mailman's AI to effortlessly read, search, and understand text embedded directly within your email attachments.

title: Advanced Pipeline Checks
subtitle: Robust verification layers
description: We are overhauling the AI pipeline with strictly enforced verification layers. This includes enhanced validation for file inputs, ensuring data integrity and preventing processing errors before they hit the core embedding models.

title: Scalability & Load Testing
subtitle: Enterprise-grade performance
description: As Mailman scales, we are implementing rigorous automated load testing across all core API endpoints. This guarantees zero downtime and lightning-fast response times even during massive email influxes.

title: Horizontal Worker Scaling
subtitle: Independent background queues
description: To maximize throughput, we are decoupling our background workers and task queues from the monolithic instance. They will soon be deployed across fully independent, horizontally scalable node clusters.
